checks.name: master genes
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM proteinatlas

checks.name: drug-target class
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM proteinatlas WHERE contains("Protein class", 'FDA approved drug targets')

checks.name: Q27 complete positive cohort
checks.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT "Gene", max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN try_cast("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) k, max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN try_cast("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) c FROM rna_tissue_consensus GROUP BY "Gene"), p AS (SELECT "Gene", max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN try_cast("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) k, max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN try_cast("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) c FROM ms_tissue GROUP BY "Gene"), es AS (SELECT m."Ensembl", log2(r.k/r.c) x, log2(p.k/p.c) y FROM proteinatlas m JOIN r ON m."Ensembl"=r."Gene" JOIN p ON m."Ensembl"=p."Gene" WHERE contains(m."Protein class", 'FDA approved drug targets') AND r.k>0 AND r.c>0 AND p.k>0 AND p.c>0) SELECT count(*) AS value FROM es

checks.name: Q27 Spearman
checks.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT "Gene", max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN try_cast("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) k, max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN try_cast("nTPM" AS DOUBLE) END) c FROM rna_tissue_consensus GROUP BY "Gene"), p AS (SELECT "Gene", max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='kidney' THEN try_cast("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) k, max(CASE WHEN "Tissue"='colon' THEN try_cast("Intensity" AS DOUBLE) END) c FROM ms_tissue GROUP BY "Gene"), es AS (SELECT m."Ensembl", log2(r.k/r.c) x, log2(p.k/p.c) y FROM proteinatlas m JOIN r ON m."Ensembl"=r."Gene" JOIN p ON m."Ensembl"=p."Gene" WHERE contains(m."Protein class", 'FDA approved drug targets') AND r.k>0 AND r.c>0 AND p.k>0 AND p.c>0), ranks AS (SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY x)+(count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x)-1)/2.0 rx,rank() OVER (ORDER BY y)+(count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY y)-1)/2.0 ry FROM es) SELECT corr(rx,ry) AS value FROM ranks

checks.name: Q28 shared measured genes
checks.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT "Gene", "Cancer", try_cast("logFC" AS DOUBLE) fc, try_cast("p-value adjusted" AS DOUBLE) p FROM cancer_cptac WHERE "Cancer" IN ('Colon AC','Lung AC','Ovary SC')), agg AS (SELECT "Gene",count(*) FILTER(WHERE fc IS NOT NULL AND p IS NOT NULL) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p<.01 AND fc>=.5) up,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p<.01 AND fc<=-.5) down FROM v WHERE "Gene" IN (SELECT "Ensembl" FROM proteinatlas) GROUP BY "Gene") SELECT count(*) AS value FROM agg WHERE n=3

checks.name: Q28 opposite significant changes
checks.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT "Gene", "Cancer", try_cast("logFC" AS DOUBLE) fc, try_cast("p-value adjusted" AS DOUBLE) p FROM cancer_cptac WHERE "Cancer" IN ('Colon AC','Lung AC','Ovary SC')), agg AS (SELECT "Gene",count(*) FILTER(WHERE fc IS NOT NULL AND p IS NOT NULL) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p<.01 AND fc>=.5) up,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p<.01 AND fc<=-.5) down FROM v WHERE "Gene" IN (SELECT "Ensembl" FROM proteinatlas) GROUP BY "Gene") SELECT count(*) AS value FROM agg WHERE n=3 AND up>0 AND down>0

checks.name: Q33 matched donors
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT "Donor" FROM rna_immune_cell_sample WHERE "Immune cell" IN ('NK-cell','memory CD8 T-cell') GROUP BY "Donor" HAVING count(DISTINCT "Immune cell")=2)

checks.name: Q43 observed MS count
checks.sql: WITH chosen AS (SELECT m."Ensembl" FROM proteinatlas m JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON m."Ensembl"=r."Gene" WHERE contains(m."Protein class", 'Transcription factors') AND r."Tissue"='colon' ORDER BY try_cast(r."nTPM" AS DOUBLE) DESC,m."Ensembl" LIMIT 20) SELECT count(*) AS value FROM chosen JOIN ms_tissue p ON chosen."Ensembl"=p."Gene" WHERE p."Tissue"='colon' AND try_cast(p."Intensity" AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL

checks.name: Q45 descriptive intersection
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM cancer_cptac c JOIN cancer_prognostic_data p ON c."Gene"=p."Gene" JOIN proteinatlas m ON c."Gene"=m."Ensembl" WHERE c."Cancer"='Lung AC' AND try_cast(c."logFC" AS DOUBLE)>=1 AND try_cast(c."p-value adjusted" AS DOUBLE)<.01 AND p."Cancer"='Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)' AND coalesce(p."validated prognostic - unfavorable",'')<>''
